company.name: Kikoff
company.shortDescription: Kikoff provides credit building services through secured cards and rent reporting.
company.description: Kikoff is a personal finance platform with a mission to turn credit builders into great borrowers. Its web and mobile app lets customers build credit, save, and check their credit scores and reports with speed, convenience, and affordability in mind.

productsAndServices.description: A revolving line of credit for financing purchases from Kikoff, reported to all three major credit bureaus to build credit through on-time payments without interest or fees.
productsAndServices.name: Kikoff Credit Account

productsAndServices.description: A secured Mastercard credit card that reports payment history to credit bureaus, helping users build credit through everyday purchases with a deposit-based credit limit.
productsAndServices.name: Kikoff Secured Credit Card

productsAndServices.description: A service that reports users' rent payments, including up to two years of past payments, to major credit bureaus to help build credit.
productsAndServices.name: Rent Reporting Service

productsAndServices.description: Subscription plans offering varying credit lines, credit bureau reporting, and additional features like rent reporting and identity theft protection to support credit building.
productsAndServices.name: Credit Building Plans (Basic, Premium, Ultimate)

productsAndServices.description: A service offering continuous monitoring and protection of users' personal data and credit information against cyber threats and data breaches.
productsAndServices.name: Privacy Protection Service

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $30,000,000, or 70.59% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $15,000,000 to $160,000,000, a 10.67x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 77 (-15 over 90 days) and market heat at 58 (-11).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Aura, EarnIn, Bilt.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
